args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities (Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay, Kailua Beach):
- Multiple swimsuits/swim trunks
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag
- Flip-flops/water shoes
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Rash guard/UV protective swim shirt

Hiking & Outdoor Activities (Diamond Head, North Shore):
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Light jacket or windbreaker
- Backpack/daypack
- Reusable water bottle
- Trail snacks
- Insect repellent

Sightseeing & Cultural Events (Pearl Harbor, Polynesian Cultural Center, Luau):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Casual but respectful clothing for Pearl Harbor
- Hawaiian shirt or tropical attire for luau
- Light sweater for evening events
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards

General Clothing:
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks
- Workout clothes
- One nicer outfit for dinner out

Toiletries & Personal Items:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash/soap
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Lip balm with SPF
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburn relief)

Electronics:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Headphones

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for downtime
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs
- Small umbrella or rain jacket
- Reusable shopping bags
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

Activities Schedule Reference:
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore
- June 16: Luau experience at Polynesian Cultural Center
- June 17: Relaxation day at the hotel spa
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center
- June 20: Departure
